# flow_kubernetes_volume (Data Source)

a volume that a persistent volume claim inside the cluster created



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) unique identifier of the cluster

### Optional

- `id` (Number) unique identifier of the volume
- `name` (String) name of the volume
- `serial_number` (String) serial number of the volume

### Read-Only

- `location_id` (Number) unique identifier of the location
- `size` (Number) size of the volume in GiB
- `status` (String) current status of the volume, as a stable key
